technique_name: Describe how artificial intelligence is beginning to impact the global economy.
description: Artificial intelligence is beginning to have a significant impact on the global economy. AI is enabling faster and more accurate data analysis and helping businesses to make better decisions. AI-driven technologies are being used in fields such as healthcare, finance, and transportation - and are expected to have a profound effect on labor markets and consumer behavior.
